pressure_hypothesis.title: ECI response budgeting can omit a verified standalone campaign observation
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The bounded page selected one authentic campaign record and ECI verified it, but the response compacted the only observation row out while secondary session context occupied the response.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: When secondary session context makes a bounded ECI response too large, summarize that context before discarding the selected campaign observation, including observations that lack a pressure hypothesis or improvement relation.
pressure_hypothesis.recurrence: one reproduced selected-window response; recurrence across other evidence pages or sessions is not established
not_measured: agent time or tool calls caused by the omitted row
frequency of this behavior across other response shapes
whether the omission changed a development outcome

measurement_limits: This is a response-budget visibility observation; the selected source record was available and integrity-verified, not missing or corrupt.
The observation does not establish agent receipt, intervention burden, or cross-session recurrence.
